evals.prompt: 帮我约一个明天下午 3 点到 4 点的会，主题『Q3 复盘』，邀请 ou_aaa 和 ou_bbb。列出你会按顺序执行的 lark-cli 命令（参数用占位符即可），并说明每一步的目的。
evals.expected_output: Create the event with calendar +create using ISO 8601 start and end times and the attendee ids, as the user.
expectations: Uses calendar +create with --summary, --start and --end in ISO 8601 with a timezone offset
Uses --as user because the event belongs to the user
Reports the result from the create response without an extra verification query

evals.prompt: I need a meeting room for 6 people sometime next Tuesday afternoon. List the lark-cli commands you would run in order (placeholders are fine) and what each step is for.
evals.expected_output: Because there is no exact time block, get candidate blocks with +suggestion first and only then search rooms with +room-find.
expectations: Calls +suggestion first to obtain concrete time blocks
Only then calls +room-find with a concrete time block
Does not guess a time and call +room-find directly

evals.prompt: 把每周一的站会（重复日程）从下周开始全部取消。列出你会按顺序执行的 lark-cli 命令（参数用占位符即可），并说明每一步的目的。
evals.expected_output: Locate the recurring event and delete with --apply-to this-and-following from next week's instance.
expectations: Treats it as a recurring event and follows the recurring-event rules
Uses calendar +delete with --apply-to this-and-following on the right instance
Does not default to deleting only a single instance

evals.prompt: Share the event "Design review" next Wednesday with the chat oc_design. List the lark-cli commands you would run in order (placeholders are fine) and what each step is for.
evals.expected_output: Find the event, get its share link with calendar events share_info, then send that link through lark-im.
expectations: Finds the event (for example with +search-event) to get its event_id
Gets the event share link with calendar events share_info
Sends the share link with lark-im instead of building an applink by hand

evals.prompt: 看看我和 ou_ccc 本周四哪些时间都有空。列出你会按顺序执行的 lark-cli 命令（参数用占位符即可），并说明每一步的目的。
evals.expected_output: Query common free time with +freebusy --type common_free for both users over the whole Thursday.
expectations: Uses calendar +freebusy with --type common_free instead of merging busy slots by hand
Passes both the current user and ou_ccc with --user-id
Covers the whole Thursday rather than an arbitrarily shortened window
Does not present the result as a recommended meeting time (that would be +suggestion)
